About this Event

Saturday Yoga & Social Hour at River North Brewery
Kick off your weekend with a rejuvenating hour of yoga at River North Brewery’s vibrant Blake St. taproom in the heart of the RiNo Arts District. Flow through an all-levels yoga class that’s perfect for beginners and seasoned yogis alike. After class, enjoy a special buy-one-get-one-free beer deal from River North Brewery’s rotating selection of craft beers.
Make the most of your afternoon with 30 minutes of social time post-class. Relax on the patio, soak up the sun, or beat the heat inside the cozy taproom. Pair your drink with mouthwatering tacos from a variety of rotating taco trucks on the patio—an ideal setting to meet new friends and enjoy the vibrant energy of the RiNo Arts District.

Event Details:
Date & Time: Every Saturday, 12:00 PM - 1:00 PM (social time from 1:00 PM - 1:30 PM)Class Duration: 60 minutesLocation: River North Brewery, 3400 Blake St, Denver, CO 80205 Google MapsCost: Donation-based, pay what you can ($15-30 suggested)What to Expect: A fun and supportive all-levels vinyasa flow class, perfect for yogis of all experience levels.

Family-Friendly Fun: All Yoga Social events are welcoming to everyone, with non-alcoholic options available for non-drinkers and under-21 guests.

What to Bring:
Yoga mat (a few extras available on a first-come, first-served basis)Water bottleComfortable clothingParking: Street parking available.
